scope: The proposed direct import of constant-feed, independent-site, self-inactivating retry yield into the retained-product model with b*x>0 lacks its whole-product self-inactivation and constant per-opportunity law. Consumed nitrogen alone does not prevent another accessible product handle from altering later donor hazards by j*b. This does not refute U1024 under its stated assumptions, nor prove actual NCL transfer rates. For x=0/inaccessible sulfur the permanent-error slope vanishes, while detour/time/competence obligations remain.
remaining_obligations: Acquire actual whole-product state/accessibility and competent equivalent return, not just absence of a second same-nitrogen amide.
Derive the appropriate conditional stage laws and charge donor/dwell/cleanup costs; an ideal harmless-loss cancellation is not free replacement.
